text:
emma_finance: Heads up — HeliosRx has escalated invoice 70111 (private deploy renewal). They say they were charged a migration surcharge and also got a "MIGRATION-CREDIT" that doesn't match the overage. Need a reconciliation.

sara_sales: Which lines are they questioning?

emma_finance: Quick excerpt I pulled: 

- Private license (annual): $95,000
- Platform fee (annual): $22,500
- Support (Standard): $3,600
- Migration surge charge: $9,000
- Credit: MIGRATION-CREDIT: -$4,000
Balance due: $126,100

They expected the surge to be fully credited per the onboarding SOW. Procurement sent a dispute.

diego_revops: I see an ops event for a 4-hour autoscale during their dataset ingest (job id: helios-ingest-2025-09-28). ops-bot: "scaling peak 130% for 4h00m". Sales had asked for a goodwill concession but I can't find the approved concession amount in the RevOps approvals doc.

ops-bot: Notice: dedicated-pool spike 2025-09-28T11:05Z. peak=130%, dur=4h00m, job=helios-ingest-20250928.

support_agent: Customer message (copied): "We were told migration surges would be waived per onboarding call. The invoice shows a partial credit only. Please correct or provide agreement reference."

lex_billing: NetSuite shows a manual credit line MIGRATION-CREDIT $4,000 but no linked credit memo id or approval code. Need an approval artifact before we post more adjustments.

emma_finance: Options: (A) full waiver of $9,000 migration surge (credit $9,000) if we can confirm onboarding SOW language; (B) apply a proportional concession (e.g., 60% = $5,400) if SOW is ambiguous; (C) deny credit if customer triggered the spike via misconfiguration. I prefer (B) unless legal confirms SOW committed to full waiver.

sara_sales: Onboarding call notes: Sales rep notes indicate we promised to "be reasonable" about migration spikes but no explicit dollar guarantee. I can reach out to procurement to get their copy of the SOW. If customer insists, sales is willing to sign a short acknowledgment accepting 40% responsibility to avoid churn.

diego_revops: I can export the onboarding SOW from the onboarding repo and timestamped call notes. I'll attach the job logs and ops-bot event to ticket FIN-2718.

lex_billing: Billing will only post a new credit memo when we have: 1) explicit approval (finance or CRO), and 2) a support/ops artifact showing spike, and 3) a signed amendment or internal approval email chain. Current MIGRATION-CREDIT $4,000 appears to be a placeholder.

emma_finance: I approve issuing up to an additional $1,400 credit (bringing total credit to $5,400 = 60% concession) conditioned on: (1) RevOps attaching ops-bot logs & job trace to FIN-2718, and (2) Sales gets customer to sign a one-paragraph amendment acknowledging split responsibility. If legal later finds the SOW obligates full waiver, we'll re-evaluate.

sara_sales: I'll request a signed amendment text now: 1-2 lines, "HeliosRx and Redwood agree migration surge will be split: HeliosRx accepts 40% responsibility; Redwood will credit 60% of surge charges for this migration." I'll ask procurement to sign within 72h.

lex_billing: Once FIN-2718 contains the ops artifacts and Sales attaches the signed amendment, Billing will post a credit memo for $1,400 (GL 4202) referencing invoice 70111 and update NetSuite accordingly. We'll also replace the placeholder MIGRATION-CREDIT entry with the formal memo id.

diego_revops: Attaching ops-bot event and job logs to FIN-2718 now. Also including the onboarding call notes export.

support_agent: I'll reply to the customer thread: "We're reviewing your concern — finance has provisionally approved a partial concession pending a short amendment. Sales will reach out about the amendment."

emma_finance: Good. Note for audit: include the internal approval string and link to FIN-2718 in the credit memo. I'll sign off on the credit once artifacts present.

sara_sales: Pinged Helios procurement, asked for 72h turnaround. Will escalate to AM if no response.

lex_billing: Summary action list: (1) Wait for signed amendment in FIN-2718; (2) RevOps has uploaded logs; (3) Finance will authorize posting $1,400 credit memo (GL 4202) once amendment present; (4) Billing to link memo to invoice 70111 and update AR.

emma_finance: Approved conditional. Tagging @sara_sales @diego_revops @lex_billing. Marking as pending until amendment. :white_check_mark:

(End of thread)
